ayahs.arabicText: حٰمٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: عٓسٓقٓ
ayahs.translation: Ayn. Sin. Qaf.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ یُوْحِیْۤ اِلَیْكَ وَ اِلَى الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ١ۙ اللّٰهُ الْعَزِیْزُ الْحَكِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Wise reveal to you even as (He revealed) to those (Messengers) who preceded you.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْعَلِیُّ الْعَظِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; He is the Most High, the All-Great.

ayahs.arabicText: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ یَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ یُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ یَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ لِمَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: The heavens may well nigh rend asunder from above while the angels proclaim the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Lo, it is Allah, and He alone, Who is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اَوْلِیَآءَ اللّٰهُ حَفِیْظٌ عَلَیْهِمْ١ۖ٘ وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ بِوَكِیْلٍ
ayahs.translation: Those who have taken others than Him as their protectors beside Him, it is Allah Who oversees them; you are no guardian over them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا لِّتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰى وَ مَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَ تُنْذِرَ یَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَیْبَ فِیْهِ١ؕ فَرِیْقٌ فِی الْجَنَّةِ وَ فَرِیْقٌ فِی السَّعِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: And thus did We reveal this Arabic Qur'an to you that you may warn the people of the Mother of Cities (to wit, Makkah) and those who dwell around it; and warn them of the Day of Gathering concerning which there is no doubt: whereon some will be in Paradise, and some in the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّ لٰكِنْ یُّدْخِلُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ فِیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ؕ وَ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ وَّلِیٍّ وَّ لَا نَصِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: If Allah had so willed, He could have made them all a single community. But He admits whomsoever He pleases into His Mercy. As to those given to wrong-doing, they shall have none as protector or helper.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اَوْلِیَآءَ١ۚ فَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الْوَلِیُّ وَ هُوَ یُحْیِ الْمَوْتٰى١٘ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: (Are they so foolish that) they have chosen others rather than Allah as their protectors? Yet it is Allah Who is the Protector and Who resurrects the dead and Who has power over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِیْهِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ فَحُكْمُهٗۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ١ؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّیْ عَلَیْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ١ۖۗ وَ اِلَیْهِ اُنِیْبُ
ayahs.translation: The judgement on whatever you differ rests with Allah. Such is Allah, my Lord; in Him I have put all my trust and to Him I always turn in devotion.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّ مِنَ الْاَنْعَامِ اَزْوَاجًا١ۚ یَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِیْهِ١ؕ لَیْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَیْءٌ١ۚ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْبَصِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: The Originator of the heavens and the earth, He has appointed for you pairs of your own kind, and pairs also of cattle. Thus does He multiply you. Naught in the universe is like Him. He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَقَالِیْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ۚ یَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ وَ یَقْدِرُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ عَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges and straitens the sustenance of whomsoever He pleases. Surely He has knowledge of everything.

ayahs.arabicText: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الدِّیْنِ مَا وَصّٰى بِهٖ نُوْحًا وَّ الَّذِیْۤ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ وَ مَا وَصَّیْنَا بِهٖۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ وَ مُوْسٰى وَ عِیْسٰۤى اَنْ اَقِیْمُوا الدِّیْنَ وَ لَا تَتَفَرَّقُوْا فِیْهِ١ؕ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِیْنَ مَا تَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَیْهِ١ؕ اَللّٰهُ یَجْتَبِیْۤ اِلَیْهِ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ وَ یَهْدِیْۤ اِلَیْهِ مَنْ یُّنِیْبُ
ayahs.translation: He has prescribed for you the religion which He enjoined upon Noah and which We revealed to you (O Muhammad), and which We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus, commanding: “Establish this religion and do not split up regarding it.” What you are calling to is very hard upon those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Allah chooses for Himself whomsoever He pleases and guides to Himself whoever penitently turns to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تَفَرَّقُوْۤا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْیًۢا بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اُوْرِثُوا الْكِتٰبَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: They did not split up except after knowledge had come to them, and then only because they wished to commit excesses against each other. Had your Lord not already decreed that judgement would be made later at an appointed time, the matter between them would surely have been decided once and for all. Indeed those who were later made the heirs of the Book are in disquieting doubt about it.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُ١ۚ وَ اسْتَقِمْ كَمَاۤ اُمِرْتَ١ۚ وَ لَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ١ۚ وَ قُلْ اٰمَنْتُ بِمَاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ كِتٰبٍ١ۚ وَ اُمِرْتُ لِاَعْدِلَ بَیْنَكُمْ١ؕ اَللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَ رَبُّكُمْ١ؕ لَنَاۤ اَعْمَالُنَا وَ لَكُمْ اَعْمَالُكُمْ١ؕ لَا حُجَّةَ بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَكُمْ١ؕ اَللّٰهُ یَجْمَعُ بَیْنَنَا١ۚ وَ اِلَیْهِ الْمَصِیْرُؕ
ayahs.translation: (This being so, O Muhammad), call people to the same religion and be steadfast about it as you were commanded, and do not follow their desires, and say (to them): “I believe in the Book Allah has sent down. I have been commanded to establish justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us all together. To Him all are destined to return.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یُحَآجُّوْنَ فِی اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِیْبَ لَهٗ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَ عَلَیْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Those who contend concerning Allah (after His call has been responded to), their contention is absolutely void in the sight of their Lord. Allah's wrath is upon them and a grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِیْۤ اَنْزَلَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ الْمِیْزَانَ١ؕ وَ مَا یُدْرِیْكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِیْبٌ
ayahs.translation: Allah it is Who sent down this Book with the Truth and the Balance. And what would make you know that the Hour (of Judgement) has drawn near?

ayahs.arabicText: یَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهَا١ۚ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُوْنَ مِنْهَا١ۙ وَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یُمَارُوْنَ فِی السَّاعَةِ لَفِیْ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten its coming. But those who believe (in it) hold it in dread and know that the Hour (of Judgement) is bound to come. Lo, those who dispute concerning the coming of the Hour are gone far in error.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَطِیْفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهٖ یَرْزُقُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ١ۚ وَ هُوَ الْقَوِیُّ الْعَزِیْزُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Allah is Most Gentle to His servants and grants sustenance to whomsoever He pleases. He is All-Strong, Most Mighty.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ كَانَ یُرِیْدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهٗ فِیْ حَرْثِهٖ١ۚ وَ مَنْ كَانَ یُرِیْدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْیَا نُؤْتِهٖ مِنْهَا وَ مَا لَهٗ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنْ نَّصِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: Whoever seeks the harvest of the Hereafter, We shall increase for him his harvest, and whoever seeks the harvest of this world, We shall give him thereof; but he will have no share in the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكٰٓؤُا شَرَعُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنَ الدِّیْنِ مَا لَمْ یَاْذَنْۢ بِهِ اللّٰهُ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Do they have any associates (of Allah) who have laid down for them a way pertaining to faith which Allah did not sanction? But for the fact that a decree had already been made, the matter between them would have been decided once and for all. Surely a grievous chastisement awaits the wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: تَرَى الظّٰلِمِیْنَ مُشْفِقِیْنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْا وَ هُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِیْ رَوْضٰتِ الْجَنّٰتِ١ۚ لَهُمْ مَّا یَشَآءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ١ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of the consequence of their deeds which will certainly overtake them. But those who have faith and do good deeds will be in the meadows of the Gardens, wherein they shall have whatever they desire from their Lord; that is the great Bounty.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِیْ یُبَشِّرُ اللّٰهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ١ؕ قُلْ لَّاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِی الْقُرْبٰى١ؕ وَ مَنْ یَّقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهٗ فِیْهَا حُسْنًا١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ شَكُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: That is the Bounty of which Allah gives tidings to His servants who have faith and do good deeds. Tell them, (O Prophet): “I do not ask you for any recompense for my work except love towards kinsfolk.” Whoever does a good deed, We shall increase its merit for him. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Appreciative.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا١ۚ فَاِنْ یَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ یَخْتِمْ عَلٰى قَلْبِكَ١ؕ وَ یَمْحُ اللّٰهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَ یُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Do they say: “He has forged a lie against Allah?” If Allah so wanted He could seal up your heart. Allah blots out falsehood and confirms the truth by His Words. He is well aware of all the secrets hidden in the breasts (of people).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ یَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَ یَعْفُوْا عَنِ السَّیِّاٰتِ وَ یَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who accepts repentance from His servants and forgives sins and knows all what you do,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسْتَجِیْبُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ یَزِیْدُهُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖ١ؕ وَ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: and answers the prayers of those who believe and do good deeds and bestows upon them even more out of His Bounty. As for those who deny (the Truth), a grievous chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ بَسَطَ اللّٰهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهٖ لَبَغَوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لٰكِنْ یُّنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا یَشَآءُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِیْرٌۢ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: If Allah were to grant ample sustenance to His servants they would go about transgressing in the land. But He sends down in due measure whatever (sustenance) He wills. Surely He is Well-Aware and All-Seeing concerning matters that relate to His servants.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ یُنَزِّلُ الْغَیْثَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْا وَ یَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهٗ١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْوَلِیُّ الْحَمِیْدُ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who sends down the rain after they despair of it, spreading out His Mercy. He is the Protector, the Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَثَّ فِیْهِمَا مِنْ دَآبَّةٍ١ؕ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى جَمْعِهِمْ اِذَا یَشَآءُ قَدِیْرٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the living creatures that He has spread out in them. He has the power to bring them together when He so wills.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِیْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَیْدِیْكُمْ وَ یَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِیْرٍؕ
ayahs.translation: Whatever misfortune befalls you is a consequence of your own deeds. But much of it He forgives.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِیْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ١ۖۚ وَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِیٍّ وَّ لَا نَصِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: You cannot frustrate Him in the earth; you have no protector nor helper against Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِی الْبَحْرِ كَالْاَعْلَامِؕ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs are the ships that sail in the sea like mountains.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ یَّشَاْ یُسْكِنِ الرِّیْحَ فَیَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلٰى ظَهْرِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوْرٍۙ
ayahs.translation: If He so wills, He can cause the winds to become still so that they will remain motionless on its surface. Surely there are many Signs in this for those who are wont to be steadfast and give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ یُوْبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْا وَ یَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِیْرٍ٘
ayahs.translation: He may, while forgiving much of the sins of those that ride these ships, drown them on account of some of their misdeeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ یَعْلَمَ الَّذِیْنَ یُجَادِلُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِنَا١ؕ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّحِیْصٍ
ayahs.translation: Then those who wrangle about Our Signs will come to know that there is no escape for them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَاۤ اُوْتِیْتُمْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۚ وَ مَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ یَتَوَكَّلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: That which has been given to you is only the wherewithal of the transient life of this world. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَجْتَنِبُوْنَ كَبٰٓئِرَ الْاِثْمِ وَ الْفَوَاحِشَ وَ اِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْا هُمْ یَغْفِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: who eschew grave sins and shameful deeds, and whenever they are angry, forgive;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اسْتَجَابُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَ اَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ١۪ وَ اَمْرُهُمْ شُوْرٰى بَیْنَهُمْ١۪ وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ یُنْفِقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: who obey their Lord and establish Prayer; who conduct their affairs by consultation, and spend out of what We have bestowed upon them;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اِذَاۤ اَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْیُ هُمْ یَنْتَصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: who, when a wrong is done to them, seek its redress.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَزٰٓؤُا سَیِّئَةٍ سَیِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا١ۚ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَ اَصْلَحَ فَاَجْرُهٗ عَلَى اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا یُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: The recompense of evil is evil the like of it. But he who forgives and makes amends, his reward lies with Allah. Surely He does not love the wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَیْهِمْ مِّنْ سَبِیْلٍؕ
ayahs.translation: There is no blame against him who avenges himself after he has been wronged.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا السَّبِیْلُ عَلَى الَّذِیْنَ یَظْلِمُوْنَ النَّاسَ وَ یَبْغُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ بِغَیْرِ الْحَقِّ١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Blame attaches only to those who subject people to wrong and commit excesses on earth. A painful chastisement awaits them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَ غَفَرَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُوْرِ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: But he who patiently endures and forgives, that is a conduct of great resolve.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ وَّلِیٍّ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ١ؕ وَ تَرَى الظّٰلِمِیْنَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الْعَذَابَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ هَلْ اِلٰى مَرَدٍّ مِّنْ سَبِیْلٍۚ
ayahs.translation: He whom Allah lets go astray, none after Him can be his protector. You will see that when the wrong-doers observe the chastisement, they will exclaim: “Is there any way to go back?”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَرٰىهُمْ یُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلَیْهَا خٰشِعِیْنَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ یَنْظُرُوْنَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِیٍّ١ؕ وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اِنَّ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ اَهْلِیْهِمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ فِیْ عَذَابٍ مُّقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: You shall see them, as they are brought face to face with the chastisement, in a state of abject humiliation, looking with a furtive glance. But the believers will say: “Surely the true losers are they who lose themselves and their kindred on the Day of Resurrection.” Lo, the wrong-doers will be in an enduring torment.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ یَنْصُرُوْنَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ سَبِیْلٍؕ
ayahs.translation: They shall have no protectors to help them against Allah. For he whom Allah causes to go astray will have no way to save himself.

ayahs.arabicText: اِسْتَجِیْبُوْا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَ یَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ مَّلْجَاٍ یَّوْمَئِذٍ وَّ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّكِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Accept the command of your Lord before there comes a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that Day there shall be no shelter for you, and none may change your predicament.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَمَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ عَلَیْهِمْ حَفِیْظًا١ؕ اِنْ عَلَیْكَ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ١ؕ وَ اِنَّاۤ اِذَاۤ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا١ۚ وَ اِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَیِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَیْدِیْهِمْ فَاِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُوْرٌ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), if they turn away from the Truth, know that We did not send you to them as their overseer. Your task is only to convey (the Message). Indeed when We give man a taste of Our Mercy, he exults in it. But if any misfortune afflicts them on account of their deeds, man is utterly ungrateful.

ayahs.arabicText: لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ١ؕ یَهَبُ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ اِنَاثًا وَّ یَهَبُ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ الذُّكُوْرَۙ
ayahs.translation: The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. He creates whatever He pleases. He grants females to whomever He pleases and males to whomever He pleases,

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ یُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَّ اِنَاثًا١ۚ وَ یَجْعَلُ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ عَقِیْمًا١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌ قَدِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: or grants them a mix of males and females, and causes whomever He pleases to be barren. He is All- Knowing, All-Powerful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنْ یُّكَلِّمَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا وَحْیًا اَوْ مِنْ وَّرَآئِ حِجَابٍ اَوْ یُرْسِلَ رَسُوْلًا فَیُوْحِیَ بِاِذْنِهٖ مَا یَشَآءُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیٌّ حَكِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: It is not given to any human being that Allah should speak to him except through revelation, or from behind a veil, or that a messenger (an angel) be sent to him who reveals to him by Allah's leave whatever He wishes. He is All-High, Most Wise.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ رُوْحًا مِّنْ اَمْرِنَا١ؕ مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِیْ مَا الْكِتٰبُ وَ لَا الْاِیْمَانُ وَ لٰكِنْ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُوْرًا نَّهْدِیْ بِهٖ مَنْ نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا١ؕ وَ اِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِیْۤ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Even so We revealed to you, (O Prophet), a spirit by Our command. (Ere to that) you knew neither what the Book nor what the faith was. But We made that spirit a light whereby We guide those of Our servants whom We please to the Right Way. Surely you are directing people to the Right Way,

ayahs.arabicText: صِرَاطِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِیْ لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ تَصِیْرُ الْاُمُوْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: the Way of Allah, to Whom belongs the dominion of all that is in the heavens and the earth. Lo, it is to Allah that all things ultimately revert.
